{{Top|leg}}
'''Stellar Legionnaire''' was the initiate-level rank of the [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]]. Legionnaires served for a provisional term of one year, in which time they could be expelled for breaches of Sun Guard etiquette. Upon finishing their term, they were promoted to [[Stellar Tribune]].

==Behind the scenes==
In creating the ranks of the Sun Guard for ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', [[Daniel Wallace]] chose names reminiscent of those of the [[Wikipedia:Roman Empire|Roman Empire]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|danwallace|150|Endnotes from Galaxy at War}}</ref>
